reason: The README documents a vision plugin whose primary user-facing purpose is image analysis, including description, OCR, visual question answering, UI layout analysis, and clipboard screenshot processing through configurable vision APIs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图片描述、OCR、视觉问答、UI 布局分析和剪贴板截图分析等视觉工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with image description, OCR, visual question answering, UI layout analysis, and clipboard screenshot analysis tools.

capabilities: Analyzes images from local paths, file URLs, HTTP(S) URLs, and data URIs
Reads screenshots from the system clipboard
Sends image data and prompts to configured OpenAI, Gemini, or OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints
Uses configured API keys and performs network requests with retries and timeouts
Transforms image attachments into text and intercepts compatible LLM stream requests
